For Supabase Edge Functions, owner redeploys a known-good function bundle/version through the approved Supabase path and verifies CORS and health afterward.

stopConditionsForFutureDeployments: Working tree is dirty at deployment time.
Approved commit SHA does not match the commit being deployed.
A wallet confirmation, signing prompt, transaction prompt, approval, mint, transfer, or production-value contract interaction appears.
Browser smoke shows an unapproved network origin without owner exception.
Required CI/CD secrets or Cloudflare build variables are missing.
Deployment would bypass the owner-approved release path.
Any high or critical security finding is introduced.
Any command requests forbidden authority beyond the deployment scope.
